lines.net1: An AI model is a huge network of simple artificial neurons, arranged in layers.
lines.net2: Each link has a weight, a number for how strongly one neuron influences the next.
lines.train1: To learn, it makes a guess, compares it with the right answer, and measures the error.
lines.train2: Then it nudges every weight to shrink that error, over billions of examples.
lines.pred1: A chat AI is trained on one simple task: predict the next word.
lines.pred2: Add a likely word, then repeat, and the patterns it learned become whole sentences.
lines.outro: Data in, patterns learned, predictions out. That is how AI works.
